text:
janet: Heads-up: cross-team sync about the long-term routing/segmentation plan. Need a single artifact that ties tiers to launch criteria and pricing.

kai: We should define 3 pragmatic tiers: low-touch shard (cost optimal), region-isolate (residency + soft affinity), tenant-island (dedicated compute).

prashant: For each tier include: p50/p95/p99 targets, kv-cache policy, allowed egress, fallback model path, and a cost multiplier estimate. Also migration/rollback playbook.

liz: Customers want "predictable tail latency" and explicit residency guarantees. They'll accept throughput limits for stronger isolation. Sales needs % uplift numbers.

janet: Launch checklist draft: 1) policy DSL example + unit validation, 2) telemetry dashboards and alert thresholds, 3) migration playbook with canary & soft-evict, 4) per-tenant cost estimate, 5) legal/residency sign-off.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: started canary rollout for policy-seed-v3 (canary-12).

kai: Operational note: cross-region kv peeking lowers cold-starts but raises egress and p99 risk. If allowed for region-isolate, document expected p99 delta and a configurable peeking window.

prashant: Migration constraints: pilot pool of 5 tenants, chaos tests for slow-link, rollback to regional-compatible variant within 15 min. Tenant-island requires Reserved Capacity commit before cutover.

liz: UI ask: a simple toggle "Strong Isolation" with tooltip showing SLA uplift and price multiplier for demos. Sales needs concrete numbers.

janet: Action items: janet -> one-pager + example DSL; prashant -> migration playbook template; kai -> cost model for peeking vs strict local; liz -> sales/demo copy with multipliers. Reconvene Tue 10am.

kai: Example compact DSL to include:
policy: tier: "region-isolate"; affinity: "soft"; kv_cache: "region-local"; fallback: "region-compatible-quantized"; sla_p99_ms: "120"

janet: Keeping DSL small for v1 reduces surprises. I'll post draft by EOD Mon.
